sloka: ना अस्य अमित्रैः गतम् गच्छेः मा शत्रुभिः अरिंदम ।भर्तुः अर्थ परो दान्तः सुग्रीव वशगो भव ॥४-२२-२२॥
transliteration: nā asya amitraiḥ gatam gaccheḥ mā śatrubhiḥ ariṁdama ।bhartuḥ artha paro dāntaḥ sugrīva vaśago bhava ॥4-22-22॥

translations.english: 'O conqueror of foes do not align with his enemies or with the friends of his enemies. Remain selfrestrained and loyal to Sugriva. Be subordinate to his will.
